body:
## Summary

`trigger_runtime` crashes with `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'lower'` when the LLM response dict doesn't contain the expected nested `"response"` key (e.g. Ollama returns `{"model": "..."}` without a `"response"` field).

**Fix:**
```python
# Before — crashes when response_text is None
response_text = (inference.get("response") or {}).get("response")
lowered = response_text.lower()

# After — guarded
if response_text:
    lowered = response_text.lower()
```

Also fixes an operator-precedence bug in the `remaining_gap` detection condition — the `or` vs `and` grouping was ambiguous and now uses explicit parentheses to match the intended logic.

Added 6 unit tests covering: None response, empty string response, valid completion, "large gap" detection, inference failure, and model-not-available scenarios.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/593a749f2ad2487fa97b298fe9ddf340
title: fix: guard against NoneType crash in trigger_runtime response handling
